name: faite
title: Faite
description: Capture, find and triage your Faite to-dos without leaving Raycast
author: Rob

commands.name: quick-add-todo
commands.title: Quick Add To-Do
commands.subtitle: Faite
commands.description: Capture a to-do without leaving what you're doing

preferences.name: shouldCloseMainWindow
preferences.title: Close Raycast
preferences.label: Close the window immediately
preferences.description: Close Raycast as soon as you hit enter, and confirm with a HUD instead of a toast.

preferences.name: dontUseAI
preferences.title: Natural Language
preferences.label: Don't use AI to parse dates and lists
preferences.description: Take the text literally instead of asking Raycast AI to pull out dates, priority and a list.

commands.name: today
commands.title: Today
commands.subtitle: Faite
commands.description: Today's to-dos — complete, reschedule or triage them

commands.name: overflow
commands.title: Overflow
commands.subtitle: Faite
commands.description: To-dos that slipped past your Faite Loop window

commands.name: search-todos
commands.title: Search To-Dos
commands.subtitle: Faite
commands.description: Search every to-do by title, list or label

commands.name: browse-lists
commands.title: Browse Lists
commands.subtitle: Faite
commands.description: Browse your lists and drill into one

commands.name: day-note
commands.title: Day Note
commands.subtitle: Faite
commands.description: Write the Markdown note for a day — today, or any date you name

commands.name: connect-account
commands.title: Connect Faite Account
commands.subtitle: Faite
commands.description: Sign in to Faite in your browser and connect it to Raycast

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Faite Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Faite
commands.description: Today's to-do count in the menu bar, with Overflow surfaced separately

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Paste a read/write key from Faite → Settings → API Keys to skip the browser sign-in.

preferences.name: apiHost
preferences.title: API Host
preferences.description: Only change this if you are running Faite locally.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the `prepublishOnly` script and rerun `npm publish` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use `npm run publish` instead.

" && exit 1

tools.name: get-todos
tools.title: Get To-Dos
tools.description: Read the caller's to-dos, filtered by status, list, day or label

tools.name: get-lists
tools.title: Get Lists
tools.description: Read the caller's lists, including what each one is for

tools.name: get-tabs
tools.title: Get Tabs
tools.description: Read the caller's tabs — the groups their lists sit in

tools.name: get-backlog
tools.title: Get Backlog
tools.description: Read to-dos that exist but have not been scheduled

tools.name: get-overflow
tools.title: Get Overflow
tools.description: Read to-dos that have slipped past their scheduled day

tools.name: get-profile
tools.title: Get Profile
tools.description: Read the caller's timezone and Faite Loop settings

tools.name: get-day-note
tools.title: Get Day Note
tools.description: Read the Markdown note for one day

tools.name: create-todo
tools.title: Create To-Do
tools.description: Add a to-do, optionally with a list, dates and priority

tools.name: set-day-note
tools.title: Set Day Note
tools.description: Write the Markdown note for one day
